title: State bounds
statement: For natural numbers $B,P$ and a state $S$, define the state bounds condition to mean that $S$ satisfies its $B$-bound, that $S.Bs+S.K\le B$ and $S.Bs+S.K\le P$, and that $S.K+1\le B$.
caveat: The upstream snippet does not define the state property $S.Bd\,B$, so its meaning cannot be rendered more explicitly.
